name: gather_gene_disease_associations
description: Query multiple gene-disease databases (DisGeNET, OMIM, OpenTargets, GenCC, ClinVar) in a single call. Returns a cross-referenced comparison table showing which sources agree on each association, with concordance scores. Use when you need to compare gene-disease evidence across databases or find associations unique to one source. Each association carries 'concordance' (how many sources named it) with two denominators: 'total_sources_queried' (all five, including any that failed) and 'total_sources_with_data' (those that actually contributed) -- use the latter, since a source with no API key configured otherwise looks like a source that disagreed. 'associations' is capped at 50 and 'per_source_results' at 10 rows per source; 'num_associations', 'truncated' and 'per_source_result_counts' give the untruncated figures and 'notes' names any truncation that applied.

gene.description: Gene symbol (e.g., 'TP53', 'BRCA1'). At least one of gene or disease required.

disease.description: Disease name (e.g., 'breast cancer', 'distal renal tubular acidosis'). At least one of gene or disease required.

return_schema.description: Unwrapped payload (result['data']) of a successful call.

num_associations.description: Size of the full concordance table, counted before the 50-row cap on 'associations'. Compare with the length of 'associations', or read 'truncated'.

total_sources_queried.description: Every source this tool attempts, including ones that failed or returned nothing. NOT a fair denominator for 'concordance' -- use 'total_sources_with_data'.

scores.description: Association score keyed by source name; sources without a numeric score are omitted.

total_sources_with_data.description: Sources that contributed at least one entity to this query, i.e. the number that could possibly have named this entity. Use as the denominator for 'concordance'.

per_source_results.description: Up to 10 raw extracted items per source, keyed by source name (DisGeNET, OMIM, OpenTargets, GenCC, ClinVar). Truncated at 10 without altering 'per_source_result_counts', which gives the real count.

evidence.description: Present only for GenCC entries (classification, e.g. Definitive, Strong, Moderate).

notes.description: Present only when the response needs explanation a reader could not derive from the numbers: a source that cannot contribute the data shape being compared, a truncation of 'associations' or 'per_source_results', or a 'total_sources_queried' denominator inflated by sources that contributed nothing.

per_source_result_counts.description: Untruncated number of entities each source returned, keyed by source name. 'per_source_results' shows at most 10 of them per source, so compare against this before reading a source's visible row count as how much data it has.

truncated.description: True when the concordance table was cut to 50 rows, i.e. when 'num_associations' exceeds the length of 'associations'. Follows the repo-wide truncated / truncation-disclosure convention; 'notes' carries the prose.
